mapper.select: SELECT tb.id, tb.user_id, tb.table_id AS time_table_id, tb.title, tb.status, tb.width, tb.start_at, tb.color, tb.schedule_id FROM time_blocks tb WHERE tb.id = #{id} AND tb.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT b.id, b.user_id, b.table_id AS time_table_id, b.title, b.status, b.width, b.start_at, b.color FROM time_blocks b JOIN time_tables t ON t.id = b.table_id WHERE b.table_id = #{timeTableId} AND b.user_id = #{userId} AND t.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT tb.id AS block_id, tb.user_id AS block_user_id, tb.table_id AS block_table_id, tb.title AS block_title, tb.status, tb.width, tb.start_at, tb.color, tbt.id AS task_id, tbt.time_block_id AS task_block_id, tbt.title AS task_title, s.id AS schedule_id, s.user_id AS schedule_user_id, s.kind, s.start_at, s.end_at, s.start_date, s.end_date, s.title AS schedule_title FROM time_blocks tb LEFT JOIN time_block_tasks tbt ON tb.id = tbt.time_block_id LEFT JOIN schedule s ON tb.schedule_id = s.id WHERE (tb.user_id = #{userId}) AND (tb.status = 'HOLD')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM time_blocks WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
